messages:
Lina (CS): Heads-up — Pegasus private cutover day 4. Customer reported intermittent 502/504s and higher tail latency during nightly backup window. They've linked this to renewals if not stabilized. Opening CS-9001.

Theo R: Quick triage from our side: ELB + NATGW show retransmit spikes and TCP resets clustered 02:12-02:20 UTC. I suspect PMTU issues plus a KMS rotation overlap.

Mei L: KMS note: their account is rotating keys at 02:15 daily and backups start 02:18. That can generate heavy KMS API calls and transient decrypt delays. Options: move rotation, stagger backup role, or add decrypt caching. Which does the customer prefer?

Pegasus NetOps: We checked VPN path, PMTU discovery sees 1400, their tunnel is still at 1500. We'll request MSS clamping on their appliance. Applied a temporary clamp to 1400 for testing.

Lina (CS): Action items: 1) @Theo attach natgw/elb traces to CS-9001; 2) @Mei propose KMS rotation options + short FAQ; 3) @Pegasus NetOps confirm MSS clamp effect after next backup window. I'll add renewal_risk flag and follow up with the AM if variance persists.

Theo R: Attached graphs and short pcap excerpt to CS-9001. Evidence of PMTU blackhole when packet size >1400. Customer's edge confirmed MSS change pending.

Mei L: Drafted KMS FAQ blurb and a cross-account decrypt audit policy snippet in the ticket. Short version: avoid synchronous backup reads during rotation or use a warm-cache pattern. I'll include exact IAM/KMS JSON in the ticket for their security team.

Pegasus NetOps: After MSS clamp applied, retransmits dropped ~80% in the last 30m sample. Monitoring during next backup window tomorrow morning.

OnboardBot: Ticket CS-9001 updated  assignees: Theo R, Mei L, Pegasus NetOps. Status: monitoring. Next update requested in 12h.

Lina (CS): Customer feedback: they like the responsiveness but asked for a single-page "network + KMS pre-cutover checklist" and an explicit note about scheduling rotations around backups. I've added that to the onboarding docs backlog and flagged renewal_risk.

Mei L: I'll PR a one-pager and the KMS rotation FAQ into onboarding repo and link the PR in CS-9001. ETA EOD.

Lina (CS): Thanks team. Keep customer-facing updates in CS-9001 so AM has a clean timeline.
